document_metadata.title: 91、INT. HALLWAY - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Lee is captured by Hu Li and Triad soldiers after a fight; she forces a grenade into his mouth and threatens to detonate it unless he complies.

entities.name: Lee sneaks through the hallway toward the soft count room
entities.description: Lee enters the hallway and moves stealthily along the walls, attempting to reach the soft count room without being detected.

entities.name: Security guards approach from the casino door
entities.description: Two security guards emerge from the casino door and move through the hallway behind Lee, forcing him to take evasive action.

entities.name: Lee hides on top of a money cart
entities.description: To avoid detection, Lee crawls over the back of a money cart and lies motionless on top of it, attempting to remain unseen.

entities.name: Lee is spotted by ceiling surveillance cameras
entities.description: While hiding on the money cart, Lee realizes he is directly beneath an overhead security camera and is clearly visible, silently reacting in panic.

entities.name: Lee discovers counterfeit super bills in the soft count room
entities.description: Lee sees into the soft count room and observes a large quantity of counterfeit super bills waiting to be distributed.

entities.name: Real money is transported to a waiting truck
entities.description: On the opposite side of the area, real money is being moved out on a cart toward a truck parked at the back entrance.

entities.name: Lee identifies additional surveillance cameras
entities.description: Lee notices two more ceiling cameras, confirming that his presence has been detected and his attempt to remain hidden has failed.

entities.name: Lee abandons hiding and confronts security guards
entities.description: Realizing he cannot proceed and has been exposed, Lee jumps down from the cart and stands in front of the vault, then turns to smile at the approaching security guards.

document_metadata.summary: Lee is captured by Hu Li and Triad soldiers after a fight; she forces a grenade into his mouth and threatens to detonate it unless he complies.

entities.name: Lee sneaks through the hallway toward the soft count room

entities.description: Lee realizes that Isabella has betrayed him again, leaving him trapped in a compromised situation with no way to retrieve the vault plates.
